collection.title: H-Files - National Security Council (NSC)/Deputies Committee (DC) Meetings Follow-up Files
collection.methodology: Every file unit was enumerated from all pages of the NARA Catalog series hierarchy. Catalog coverage dates control the working chronology except where the opening withdrawal sheet or meeting sheet documents a more reliable date or corrects a folder-title error. NARA extracted text supplies high-level and economic-policy review signals for every online PDF. Routing reflects manual review of the title, withdrawal-sheet descriptions, and OCR evidence. Marker status requires the opening OCR segment to name the record group, office, series, subseries, and folder ID.
